english: A little lighthouse blinks.
The light makes a path.
Gail sees the harbor.
The light points away.
The boats go in circles.
A keeper comes.
More light is not the answer.
Gail looks at the glass.
The lens has moved.
The light hits the wall.
Gail sees the angle.
Turn it a little.
The beam misses.
The marks are different.
The beam reaches the sea.
The lighthouse shines steadily.
The boats enter the harbor.
The keeper saves the mark.
The model glows again.
Gail is home.
chinese: 小燈塔閃了一下。
光做出一條路。
瑜瑜看見港口。
光照錯方向了。
小船繞圈圈。
守護員來了。
加亮也不行。
瑜瑜看玻璃。
鏡片歪了。
光照在卡片上。
瑜瑜看角度。
轉一點點。
光還沒對準。
兩個記號不同。
光照到海面了。
燈塔穩定發亮。
小船進港了。
守護員留下記號。
模型又發光了。
瑜瑜回家了。

english: A tiny lighthouse model blinks beside Gail's bed.
Its light spreads across the bedroom floor. Gail follows the glowing path.
Gail steps into a quiet harbor. Paper boats float near the shore.
The lighthouse beam shines toward a hill. It does not reach the water.
The paper boats circle near the harbor. Gail notices that they are not moving in.
The lighthouse keeper meets Gail. He wants to find what changed.
The keeper makes the lamp brighter. The beam still points at the hill.
Gail and the keeper check the clean glass. Nothing blocks the light.
A lens inside the safe display model is tilted. Gail sees where the beam goes.
Gail follows the light on a white card. The reflection shows its path.
The keeper marks the old angle on the model. Gail compares it with the sea.
Gail rotates the model lens a little. The light moves across the card.
The test beam now points past the harbor. Gail asks to try again.
Gail points to two marks on the card. The keeper sees the gap.
They adjust the model again. Its beam points across the water.
The keeper sets the real lens safely. The lighthouse gives a steady flash.
The paper boats follow the signal. One by one, they reach the harbor.
The keeper records the angle. Next time he can check it quickly.
The keeper thanks Gail. The little model flashes and opens the path home.
Gail sets the model by her bed. She remembers to look and test.
chinese: 一座迷你燈塔在瑜瑜床邊閃光。
燈光沿著臥室地板延伸。瑜瑜跟著亮路走。
瑜瑜走進安靜的港口。紙船漂在岸邊。
燈塔光束照向山坡，沒有照到水面。
紙船在港口附近繞圈。瑜瑜發現它們沒有進港。
燈塔守護員遇見瑜瑜。他想找出哪裡改變了。
守護員把燈調亮。光仍照向山坡。
瑜瑜和守護員查看乾淨的玻璃。光沒有被擋住。
安全模型裡的鏡片歪了。瑜瑜看見光照向哪裡。
瑜瑜沿著白卡上的光看。反射顯示光的路徑。
守護員在模型上標出舊角度。瑜瑜拿它與海面方向比較。
瑜瑜稍微轉動模型鏡片。光沿著卡片移動。
測試光束越過港口。瑜瑜想再試一次。
瑜瑜指出卡片上的兩個記號。守護員看見差距。
他們再次調整模型。光束指向水面。
守護員安全地調整真鏡片。燈塔穩定閃光。
紙船跟著訊號，一艘接一艘進港。
守護員記下角度，下次就能快速核對。
守護員謝謝瑜瑜。小模型閃光，打開回家的路。
瑜瑜把模型放在床邊。她記得先觀察再測試。

english: A tiny lighthouse model blinks twice beside Gail's bed. She watches it pause before the next flash.
The model's light traces a glowing path across the familiar bedroom floor. When it reaches the window, a doorway to the coast appears.
Gail arrives at a quiet harbor where small paper boats and a toy ship drift on calm water. A tall lighthouse stands beyond the stone wall.
The lighthouse sends its bright beam toward an inland hill instead of across the sea. The boats cannot see the usual way into the harbor.
Several paper boats circle safely in the sheltered water. Gail notices that each one turns before reaching the harbor entrance.
The adult lighthouse keeper joins Gail at the shore. He says the beacon was steady yesterday, so they begin by looking for what changed.
The keeper tries a brighter setting, but the beam still lands on the hill. Gail sees that a dim or bright beam cannot fix the wrong direction.
Gail checks the outer glass while the keeper inspects the lamp safely. The glass is clear, so a dirty window is not the cause.
The keeper shows Gail a small working model of the lighthouse lens. Its tilted lens bends the test beam toward the hill.
They place a white card beside the model and follow the reflected light. The bright patch makes the beam's path easy to see.
The keeper marks the model's starting angle before changing anything. Gail compares that mark with the direction of the harbor entrance.
With the keeper beside her, Gail rotates only the safe model lens a little. They watch the beam move across the card instead of changing several things at once.
Their first test sends the beam beyond the harbor entrance. Gail does not call it finished; she compares the new position with the marked target.
Gail places the first and second marks side by side. The distance between them shows how much the lens needs to turn back.
They make one smaller adjustment and test again. This time the model beam crosses the water toward the harbor entrance.
Using the tested mark, the keeper safely sets the real lighthouse lens. A steady flash now crosses the water where the boats can see it.
The clear signal can guide the paper boats through the calm entrance. One by one, they reach the sheltered harbor without circling again.
The keeper records the working angle and tests one more flash. Gail sees how a careful note can help them check the beacon next time.
After the keeper thanks Gail, the tiny model flashes twice again. Its light scatters gently into a path back to her bedroom.
Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail sets the little lighthouse beside her bed. She remembers to observe, test one change, and check where the light goes.
chinese: 一座迷你燈塔模型在瑜瑜床邊閃了兩下。她看見它停頓後才再次發亮。
模型的光沿著熟悉的臥室地板畫出亮路。光到達窗邊時，一道通往海岸的門出現了。
瑜瑜來到安靜的港口，小紙船與一艘玩具小船漂在平靜水面上。一座高燈塔立在石牆後。
燈塔明亮的光束照向內陸山坡，沒有照到海面。紙船看不見平常進港的方向。
幾艘紙船在避風水域安全地繞圈。瑜瑜發現它們每次到港口入口前都轉回去。
一位成年燈塔守護員來到瑜瑜身邊。他說昨天的燈光還很穩定，於是兩人先找出哪裡改變了。
守護員試著把燈調亮，光束仍落在山坡。瑜瑜看見，無論光線暗或亮，都無法單靠亮度修正方向。
瑜瑜查看外側玻璃，守護員安全地檢查燈具。玻璃乾淨，因此不是髒窗擋住了光。
守護員給瑜瑜看一個可操作的燈塔鏡片模型。傾斜的鏡片把測試光束導向山坡。
兩人把白卡放在模型旁，沿著反射的光看。明亮的光斑讓光束走向變得清楚。
守護員在調整前先標出模型原本的角度。瑜瑜拿這個記號對照港口入口的方向。
守護員在旁陪同，瑜瑜只稍微轉動安全模型的鏡片。他們看光束沿白卡移動，沒有同時改動多個地方。
第一次測試讓光束越過港口入口。瑜瑜沒有急著說完成，而是把新位置與標出的目標比較。
瑜瑜把前後兩個記號並排看。記號之間的距離顯示鏡片還要轉回多少。
他們做了更小的調整，再測一次。這次模型光束越過水面，指向港口入口。
守護員依測試記號安全地調整真正的燈塔鏡片。穩定的閃光越過水面，紙船都看得見。
紙船沿著清楚的訊號穿過平靜入口。它們一艘接一艘進入避風港，不再繞圈。
守護員記下有效的角度，又測了一次閃光。瑜瑜看見，仔細記錄能幫助下次檢查燈塔。
守護員向瑜瑜道謝後，迷你模型再次閃兩下。柔和光點散開，形成通往她臥室的路。
回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把小燈塔放在床邊。她記得先觀察、一次測一個改變，再確認光照到哪裡。
